lines.japanese: 「ぱね田く～ん」
lines.english: “Paneeeda.”

lines.japanese: 今日も甘ったるい声をあげて、渡来明日香が俺の前の席に座った。弁当の包みをどんと置く。
lines.english: Asuka Watarai took the seat in front of me, once again calling to me in that syrupy voice. She plunked down her wrapped lunch.

lines.japanese: 「見てこれ、自分で作ってきたの。おいしそうでしょ」
lines.english: “Look. I made it myself. Doesn't it look good?”

lines.japanese: 「なあ渡来明日香」
lines.english: “Listen, Asuka Watarai.”

lines.japanese: 「あげないよ」
lines.english: “You can't have any.”

lines.japanese: 「おまえ最近、いつものお昼メイトはどうしたんだ。やっぱり俺みたいなハンサムとばっかツルんでるから、同性にやっかまれちゃったのか？」
lines.english: “What happened to your usual lunch friends lately? Have the other girls gotten jealous because you spend all your time with a handsome man like me?”

lines.japanese: 「あ、私のお友達はみんな受験組なんだよね。お昼休みも図書室で勉強しつつ食べるんだって。私、推薦で決まってるから邪魔するわけにもいかなくて」
lines.english: “Oh, all my friends are taking entrance exams. They eat lunch in the library while they study. I got in by recommendation, so I'd only be a distraction.”

lines.japanese: 「だから一緒に食べる相手がほしかったんだ。いいところにいたよぱね田」
lines.english: “That's why I wanted somebody to eat with. Lucky I found you, Paneda.”

lines.japanese: 「私もいいかな」
lines.english: “May I join you?”

lines.japanese: 続いて山科京もやってきた。最近はこの面子で顔を合わせる日が多くなった気がする。
lines.english: Miyako Yamashina arrived next. It felt as though the three of us had been together rather often lately.

lines.japanese: まあ、ごはんはひとりで食うより大勢で食った方が楽しい。悪くはないんだけどさ。
lines.english: Well, a meal was more enjoyable with company than alone. I didn't mind.

lines.japanese: ある程度は好奇や嫉妬の視線に晒されるが、残りの授業日数を考えれば無事逃げきれることだろう。
lines.english: We attracted our share of curious and jealous looks, but with so few school days left, I would probably make it out unscathed.

lines.japanese: 目の前の女ふたりは呑気そうに話してる。わりと仲良かったんだな。今まであんまり話してるところは見たことなかったけど、相性が良いのかもしれない。
lines.english: The two women before me chatted without a care in the world. They were closer than I'd realized. I hadn't often seen them talk before, but perhaps they were well suited.

lines.japanese: 俺は自分で買ってきたパンを袋から出して喰らいついた。
lines.english: I took the bread I'd bought from its wrapper and bit into it.

lines.japanese: 「ところで山科、鳳凰寺カケルって知ってる？」
lines.english: “By the way, Yamashina, have you heard of Kakeru Hououji?”

lines.japanese: 「ぶはっ」
lines.english: “Pfft!”

lines.japanese: 飲みこむ前に吐きだすところだった。なんか今とんでもないこと言ったぞこの女。
lines.english: I nearly spat out the food before I could swallow. This woman had just said something outrageous.

lines.japanese: 「あれ、ぱね田くん知ってるの？」
lines.english: “Oh? You know him, Paneda?”

lines.japanese: 「い、いや、名前くらいだけど……」
lines.english: “N-no. Just the name...”

lines.japanese: 「そのひとがどうかしたの？」
lines.english: “What about him?”

lines.japanese: 「うん、イラストレーターなんだけど、最近気に入ってて」
lines.english: “He's an illustrator. I've gotten really into his work lately.”
“R-really...”

lines.japanese: 渡来明日香とカケルくんかあ……センスが合うんだろうか。あまりお近付きにはなって欲しくない組み合わせだ。
lines.english: Asuka Watarai and Kakeru... Did they share the same taste? They were two people I would rather not see get to know each other.

lines.japanese: 「でもそれ、クロードには言わない方がいいぞ」
lines.english: “You probably shouldn't tell Claude that.”

lines.japanese: 「え、なんで？」
lines.english: “Why not?”

lines.japanese: 「あのひと鳳凰寺カケルすんごく嫌ってるから」
lines.english: “He absolutely hates Kakeru Hououji.”

lines.japanese: 「へえ、先輩も好きそうなのになあ」
lines.english: “Really? I would have thought he'd like him too.”

lines.japanese: 「うん、だから嫌いなんだと思うよ」
lines.english: “Yeah. That's probably why he hates him.”

lines.japanese: 「なんで？」
lines.english: “Why?”

lines.japanese: 「まあ、同属嫌悪？」
lines.english: “Hatred of his own kind?”

lines.japanese: 曖昧に答えておいた。さっさと流して別の話題にしてしまおう。
lines.english: I gave her a vague answer. Better to let it pass and change the subject quickly.

lines.japanese: 「そういや山科さんは進学組じゃなかったっけ。昼休みに勉強しなくていいの」
lines.english: “Weren't you college-bound, Yamashina? Don't you need to study during lunch?”

lines.japanese: 「うん、ある程度は見込みついてるから。自分の学力より上の大学にいくつもりもないし」
lines.english: “No. I have a pretty good idea where I can get in, and I'm not aiming for a university above my level.”

lines.japanese: 「へえ、そうなの。凄いじゃん、やま……」
lines.english: “Really? That's impressive, Yama...”

lines.japanese: あれ？　このひとの名前なんだっけ？
lines.english: Wait. What was her name?

lines.japanese: 「ぱね田くん？」
lines.english: “Paneda?”

lines.japanese: なんだかいま一瞬だけ思考がトンだ。俺は後ろ頭をがしがし掻いて頭をしゃっきりさせた。
lines.english: For an instant just now, my train of thought had vanished. I scratched vigorously at the back of my head, trying to clear it.

lines.japanese: 「あ、ああ、悪い、ちょっとぼーっとしてた」
lines.english: “Oh. Sorry. I spaced out for a second.”

lines.japanese: 「あはは、普段からぼーっとしてるんだから今さらだよね」
lines.english: “Ahaha. You always look spaced out, so what's new?”

lines.japanese: 「あァ？　んだコラ、このションベン女。ひとのことげっ歯類みたいな扱いすんのやめてくんない。てめえのドタマ、クルミばりにカリカリかじり殺すぞコノヤロウ」
lines.english: “The fuck? Listen here, you little piss girl. Quit treating me like some damn rodent. I'll gnaw through your skull like a walnut, you hear me?”

lines.japanese: 「う、うわっ、ガラ悪っ」
lines.english: “W-wow. What happened to your manners?”

lines.japanese: 「ほんとだ。羽田君どうしたの？」
lines.english: “She's right. What's wrong, Haneda?”

lines.japanese: 「あ？　べつにガラ悪くなんかねーっつの。ニヒルでクールなハードボイルドだっつうの。これが俺の普通──」
lines.english: “Huh? My manners are fine. I'm a cool, cynical hard-boiled man. This is how I always—”

lines.japanese: ──普通じゃない。これじゃまるで成田隼人だ。
lines.english: —No. It wasn't. This was exactly like Hayato Narita.

lines.japanese: なんだか分からないが、隼人の人格が表面に出てしまったみたいだ。俺は意識して隼人を引っこめようとした。
lines.english: I did not know why, but Hayato's personality seemed to have risen to the surface. I consciously tried to push him back down.

lines.japanese: 「やだなあお二人とも！　今のはランチタイムを楽しく過ごすための小粋なギャグっていうか……ははは。こんなにウケないとは、自分でもくりびつ天仰略してアンビリですよ」
lines.english: “Oh, come now, ladies! That was merely a witty jest designed to enliven our luncheon... Hahaha. For it to fall so flat has left me boggle-eyed and thunderstruck—unbeli, for short.”

lines.japanese: 「は、はあ？」
lines.english: “E-excuse me?”

lines.japanese: まずいまずい、今度は鷲介だ。このままじゃ駄目だ、意識のチャンネルを戻さなければ。早く、早くこの場をごまかせる誰かに……。
lines.english: Bad. Bad. Now I was Shusuke. This would not do. I had to change the channel back. Quickly—quickly, to someone who could smooth this over...

lines.japanese: 隼人……は不器用だ、鷲介はいま失敗した。かと言ってタカシだと天然が過ぎて余計なことを喋ってしまいそうだ。ええと、それじゃあと残ってるのは──
lines.english: Hayato was too clumsy. Shusuke had just failed. But Takashi was so guileless he might let something slip. Who did that leave—

lines.japanese: 「もはは愚弟ども、ここは余に任せるがよい」
lines.english: “Mohaha! Foolish younger brethren, leave this matter to Us.”

lines.japanese: ──最悪だ！
lines.english: —the worst possible choice!

lines.japanese: 「我は賢兄。この程度の危機、ブングスタルフの荒波に比べればなにほどのことやある！　だがやはり冒険譚には色恋沙汰が付き物やもしれぬ。おいそこのハーレムナンバー００１、脱げ」
lines.english: “We are the wise elder brother! A crisis of this paltry magnitude is nothing beside the raging seas of Bungstalf! Yet every heroic adventure may indeed require an affair of the heart. You there, Harem Number 001. Undress.”

lines.japanese: 「寝ぼけてんのか」
lines.english: “Are you talking in your sleep?”

lines.japanese: 「よいよい、照れるな。貴様には余の後宮へ入る栄誉を与えるのだ、悠然と構えておれ。うぉんむ、うぉんむ。しからば早よう脱がんか、おい聞いてるのかハーレムナンバー００２」
lines.english: “There, there, do not be shy. We grant you the honor of entering Our seraglio. Bear yourself with dignity. Wom, wom. Now hurry and undress. Are you listening, Harem Number 002?”

lines.japanese: 「え、私？　渡来さんじゃなかったっけ？」
lines.english: “Me? Wasn’t Watarai Number 002?”

lines.japanese: 「む、もっともだ。ううむ、聡明な娘よのう。だがよくよく見れば貴様も充分かわいいじゃん、ひゃっほーぅ！　やや、いかんいかん、年甲斐もなく感奮の赴くまま跳ねてしてしまった。いいから双方、早よう脱げ」
lines.english: “Hm. Quite so. What a clever maiden. Yet upon closer inspection, you are plenty cute too—yahoo! Oh, no, no. At Our age, We should not have leaped so freely at passion's bidding. Enough talk. Both of you, undress at once.”

lines.japanese: やめろ変態、ブッ殺すぞコノヤロウ。ばふん、せっかく場をとりもってやったというのに、なりたなりたと騒ぎたてる俺がおるな。あー、そんだら、おれの出ばんだいねー。あとは兄ちゃんにまかせとけてー。
lines.english: Stop it, pervert. I’ll fucking kill you, asshole. Bah-fum! After I so graciously rescued the situation, someone inside Us is shouting Narita, Narita. Ah—well then, looks like it’s my turn. Leave the rest to Big Brother.

lines.japanese: 「なー、あすかー」
lines.english: “Hey, Asuka.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、あすか？」
lines.english: “A-Asuka?”

lines.japanese: わー、よく見たらこのねーちん、すんげーキレー。でもおれは、大人の女のひとって子どもにやさしいの知ってっから、あやまったふりすればゆるしてくれると思った。
lines.english: Wow. Looking close, this lady was real pretty. But I knew grown-up ladies were nice to kids, so I figured if I pretended to say sorry, she'd forgive me.

lines.japanese: 「ごめんなさい。おれ、わりーことしてねーも。ホントだよ？」
lines.english: “I'm sorry. I didn't do nothin' bad. Honest.”

lines.japanese: 「わ、悪いことってなんのこと？」
lines.english: “B-bad? What are you talking about?”
“Oh.”

lines.japanese: そいや悪いことっつっても、おれ、なんもわりぃことしてねーじゃん。
lines.english: Come to think of it, even if I said bad, I hadn't done nothin' bad at all.

lines.japanese: よかった。あすかのねーちん、おこってないや。じゃあ、いたずらしても許してくれっかな。
lines.english: Good. Asuka wasn't mad. Maybe she'd let me off if I played a little prank.

lines.japanese: うーん、どんないたずらがいいかな。おっぱい大っきいから、あれさわってみよーかな。おれのカンだけど、たぶん５かいぐらいなら、さわってもゆるしてくれそうなカオしてる。
lines.english: Hmm. What kinda prank? She's got real big boobs. Maybe I'll touch 'em. Just a hunch, but she looks like she'd forgive me maybe five times.

lines.japanese: 「なんか見てるんだけど……」
lines.english: “You're staring at something...”

lines.japanese: 「お、おまえなんか見てねえようっ！　なーに言ってんのブース！　うんこブース！」
lines.english: “I-I'm not lookin' at you! What're you talking about, uggo! Poop uggo!”

lines.japanese: 「いや見てたじゃん」
lines.english: “You were staring.”

lines.japanese: 「み、見てないもん……ううっ、見てないやい、ひっく……」
lines.english: “W-was not... Ugh, I wasn't, hic...”

lines.japanese: 「羽田君、体調悪い？」
lines.english: “Haneda, are you feeling sick?”

lines.japanese: うう、あすかのねーちん、おっかないーくてキライ。みやねーちゃんの方が１００兆万ばいやさしい。
lines.english: Ugh. Asuka was scary. I hated her. Miya was a hundred trillion bajillion times nicer.

lines.japanese: 「ぐずっ……もうおれダメ。アタマいたいし、かわいそ病でしんじゃうかもしんない」
lines.english: “Sniff... I'm done for. My head hurts, and I might die of Poor-Little-Me Disease.”

lines.japanese: 「えっ、熱あるの？」
lines.english: “What? Do you have a fever?”

lines.japanese: みやねーちゃんがアタマぴとってさわってくれた。ひんやりして気もちいーくて、おれちょっとホッとしちった。
lines.english: Miya pressed a hand to my forehead. It was cool and felt real nice, and I relaxed a little.

lines.japanese: 「うふふーう、もうダメだいねー」
lines.english: “Hee-hee... I'm all done for.”

lines.japanese: ふらふらってして、みやねーちゃんのヒザにアタマのっけてみた。あー、すべすべして気もちー。
lines.english: I swayed and tried resting my head on Miya's lap. Ahh. So smooth. It felt nice.

lines.japanese: 「平気？　保健室連れていこうか？」
lines.english: “Are you all right? Should I take you to the nurse's office?”

lines.japanese: みやねーちゃん、やせてんのに足はやっこいなー。うふふ、ふにふにしてるー。
lines.english: Miya was skinny, but her legs were soft. Hee-hee. Squishy.
“What?!”

lines.japanese: 「えへへー、みやねーちゃんやさしーくて、なんかユキ姉みたい。ふにふにー」
lines.english: “Hee-hee. Miya, you're so nice. Kinda like Yuki. Squishy.”

lines.japanese: 「ぱね田くん？　子供じゃないんだからシャレにならんよ？」
lines.english: “Paneda? You're not a child, so this isn't funny.”

lines.japanese: あ、そうだ。おれ子どもじゃないんだった。
lines.english: Oh, right. I wasn't a kid.

lines.japanese: そそ、そうだ、俺子供じゃないんだった……ってか俺！　何してんだ！
lines.english: R-right. I'm not a child... Wait—me! What am I doing?!

lines.japanese: 俺は慌ててユキ姉……誰だそれ、じゃなくて山科京の足から頭を起こし、しゃっきり背を伸ばした。
lines.english: I hurriedly lifted my head from Yuki's—who was that? From Miyako Yamashina's leg, and snapped my back straight.

lines.japanese: 「や、えーと……」
lines.english: “Uh, um...”

lines.japanese: 「す、すまん山科京。ちょっと熱があって頭がぼけてたみたいだ」
lines.english: “S-sorry, Miyako Yamashina. I think I have a fever and my head went foggy.”

lines.japanese: 「ん？　だから保健室行く？」
lines.english: “Hm? Then do you want to go to the nurse's office?”

lines.japanese: 「あ、うん。そうする……」
lines.english: “Oh. Yes. I'll do that...”

lines.japanese: 「あ、じゃあ付き添うよ」
lines.english: “Then I'll come with you.”

lines.japanese: 「い、いやいいっ！　一人で行くっ！」
lines.english: “N-no, it’s fine! I’ll go by myself!”

lines.japanese: いまは迷惑をかけたのが女神のような山科さんだったから許されたものの、万一また自我がブッ飛んで、悪魔の渡来に手を出そうものなら……あわわわわ。
lines.english: This time the person I had troubled was the goddesslike Yamashina, so I had escaped punishment. But if my sense of self went flying again and I laid hands on the demon Watarai... Oh no, no, no.

lines.japanese: 俺は女神と悪魔を振りはらって逃げだし、五時間目はベッドの中で過ごした。
lines.english: I shook off goddess and demon alike and fled. I spent fifth period in a bed.

lines.japanese: まずいな。明らかに俺たちの均衡が崩れだしてる。ここのとこ疲れてたからだろうか。
lines.english: This was bad. The balance among us was plainly beginning to collapse. Was it because I had been so tired lately?

lines.japanese: 明日からはゆっくり過ごすことにしよう。
lines.english: Starting tomorrow, I would take things easy.

lines.japanese: 駅からの帰り道、途中にある小学校から下校時刻の音楽が聞こえてきた。
lines.english: On the way home from the station, I heard the end-of-day music from an elementary school along the route.

lines.japanese: 校舎のてっぺんにある時計を見てびっくり。まだ１７時にもなってなかった。随分日の入りが早くなったな。
lines.english: The clock atop the school building startled me. It wasn't even five yet. The sun was setting awfully early now.

lines.japanese: ていうか今日だか明日だかが冬至なんだから日が短くて当然じゃん。刺すような風に当てられて、思わずコートの二の腕をぎゅっとつかんだ。気温から優しさが抜けきってる。
lines.english: Then again, today or tomorrow was the winter solstice, so of course the days were short. A biting wind struck me, and I instinctively clutched the upper arms of my coat. The temperature had been stripped of every last trace of kindness.

lines.japanese: そうだ、コーンポタージュでも買おう。こんな寒い日はホット缶でも買わないとやってられん。必要経費だ。
lines.english: Right. I'd buy some corn soup. On a day this cold, you couldn't carry on without a hot can from a vending machine. A necessary expense.

lines.japanese: 「つ、粒入りがないだと！？」
lines.english: “N-no corn pieces?!”

lines.japanese: ことの重大さに俺は煩悶を繰りかえした。ふいに浮かぶロイヤルミルクティーの１０文字。こちらにするべきか否や。
lines.english: I writhed beneath the gravity of the discovery. Then another possibility floated into my mind: royal milk tea. Was that the better choice?

lines.japanese: 「よし決めた」
lines.english: “Decision made.”

lines.japanese: 俺は財布を取りだすと、数枚の硬貨を指でつまんで挿入口に近づけた。
lines.english: I took out my wallet, pinched several coins between my fingers, and brought them toward the slot.

lines.japanese: 「ああぁー、待ってー！」
lines.english: “Aaaah! Wait!”

lines.japanese: 「おっ？」
lines.english: “Hm?”

lines.japanese: 俺の後ろを子供が駆けていく。この寒い中よくあんな元気に走れるな。
lines.english: A child raced past behind me. How could anyone run with that much energy in this cold?

lines.japanese: そういや子供のころは俺も冬の方が元気だった気がする。寒いから走って体を温めたりして――子供のころ？
lines.english: Come to think of it, winter had seemed to make me more energetic when I was a child too. You ran to warm yourself because it was cold—when I was a child?

lines.japanese: 俺はまたぶるんと頭を振った。小鳩も言っていた。今は思いださなくてもいいことだ。
lines.english: I gave my head another hard shake. Kobato had said so too. I did not have to remember yet.

lines.japanese: どんどん駆けて小さくなっていく姿は、公園の入り口で曲がって見えなくなった。
lines.english: The dwindling figure ran on, turned at the entrance to a park, and disappeared.

lines.japanese: 缶を口につけてぶらぶらと歩きながら家に辿りついた。戸締りがしてあるところを見ると、小鳩もまだ帰ってないみたいだ。
lines.english: I put the can to my lips and wandered the rest of the way home. The locked door suggested Kobato wasn't back yet either.

lines.japanese: 「おかえり、ドラ」
lines.english: “Welcome home, Dora.”

lines.japanese: 「……いらっさい」
lines.english: “...Welcome.”

lines.japanese: 代わりにドアの前にちょこんとしゃべる人形が座っていた。この光景をご近所様はどんな風に受けとっているんだろう。
lines.english: Instead, a talking doll sat neatly in front of the door. I wondered what the neighbors made of this tableau.

lines.japanese: 「こんなとこいたら寒いだろ。ほら入れ」
lines.english: “You'll freeze sitting out here. Come on, get inside.”

lines.japanese: 「ありがとぅー」
lines.english: “Thank youuu.”

lines.japanese: 背中を押しながら家に入れてしまったが、果たしてこの構図は正しいんだろうか。とりあえず誰にも見られてないことを祈った。
lines.english: I ushered her in with a hand at her back, though I was not sure this was how things were supposed to work. For now, I prayed nobody had seen us.

lines.japanese: 「で、小鳩に会いに来たのか」
lines.english: “So. Did you come to see Kobato?”

lines.japanese: 「女にそんなことを聞くものじゃないわ」
lines.english: “You do not ask a lady a question like that.”

lines.japanese: 「じゃあ帰れ」
lines.english: “Then go home.”

lines.japanese: 俺は扉を開けて速やかにご退場を願った。
lines.english: I opened the door and invited her to make a prompt exit.

lines.japanese: 「ドラ、手が冷たい。ココアがいい」
lines.english: “Dora, my hands are cold. I would like cocoa.”

lines.japanese: 「なんで当たり前のようにひとのこと使ってんだよ。まさか小鳩がいるときもそんなんか」
lines.english: “Why do you order me around like it's the most natural thing in the world? You're not like this when Kobato's here too, are you?”

lines.japanese: 「小鳩には私がいれてあげます」
lines.english: “I make cocoa for Kobato.”

lines.japanese: 俺は心の雑巾汁を絞りつつ、台所でココアを二人分入れた。
lines.english: Wringing the dirty dishwater from the rag of my heart, I made two cups of cocoa in the kitchen.

lines.japanese: 「で、また小鳩に日本語を習いにきたのか」
lines.english: “So, you came for another Japanese lesson from Kobato?”

lines.japanese: 「おっしゃるとおりです」
lines.english: “It is as you say.”

lines.japanese: ココアを飲みながら、アリスは目を閉じてほうっと息をついた。
lines.english: Alice closed her eyes and breathed out contentedly over her cocoa.

lines.japanese: 「小鳩はとても丁寧、私に親切です。この家も非常に居ごこちがよいので、たいへん満足しています」
lines.english: “Kobato is very attentive. She is kind to me. This house is also exceedingly comfortable, and I am very satisfied.”

lines.japanese: 「そ、それはどうも」
lines.english: “Th-thank you very much.”

lines.japanese: 「あなたも少しは見ならいなさい」
lines.english: “You should try to follow her example.”

lines.japanese: 「しょ、精進します」
lines.english: “I-I shall devote myself to improvement.”

lines.japanese: 「フフッ、あなたには期待してるのよ」
lines.english: “Hee-hee. I expect great things of you.”

lines.japanese: 「ただいまー」
lines.english: “I'm home!”

lines.japanese: 「お兄ちゃん、もしかしてアリスちゃん来て……あ、二人で話してたんだね」
lines.english: “Big Brother, is Alice already—oh. You two were talking.”

lines.japanese: 「いや、一人が勝手にしゃべってた」
lines.english: “No. One of us was talking without permission.”
“What?”

lines.japanese: 「あ、いや、勉強しに来たらしいぞ。小鳩は先生の筋がいいって」
lines.english: “Oh, nothing. Apparently she came to study. She says you have the makings of a fine teacher.”

lines.japanese: 「ほっ？」
lines.english: “Huh?”

lines.japanese: 「よけいなことは言わないでください。あなたは足りません感情に対する配慮、その微妙なニュアンス」
lines.english: “Do not say unnecessary things. You are lacking consideration toward feelings, those delicate nuances.”

lines.japanese: 「どだいあなたはお呼びじゃありません。私は小鳩の部屋にいきたい」
lines.english: “From the beginning, nobody invited you. I wish to go to Kobato's room.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、うん。じゃあ一緒に行こうか」
lines.english: “Oh. Sure. Let's go together.”

lines.japanese: 「待て、二人だけでやるのもいいが、外に出て色んなひとと話さなければ成長が確かめられないぞ」
lines.english: “Wait. Private lessons are fine, but unless you go outside and speak to different people, you won't know whether you're improving.”

lines.japanese: 「え、そういうもの？」
lines.english: “Oh. Is that how it works?”

lines.japanese: 「い、いいです、私は小鳩と二人がいい」
lines.english: “N-no, thank you. I prefer to be alone with Kobato.”

lines.japanese: 「ほら見なさい、こんなところに個人レッスンの弊害が。このままじゃ小鳩以外とは話せなくなっちゃうぞ。というわけで俺も混ぜてよう」
lines.english: “See? The harmful effects of private tutoring are already appearing. At this rate, she'll lose the ability to speak with anyone but Kobato. Therefore, let me join youuu.”

lines.japanese: 「うーん、じゃあ……三人で散歩でもする？」
lines.english: “Hmm. Then... shall the three of us go for a walk?”

lines.japanese: 「ドラは女性の心を理解できていません。勉強するべきです」
lines.english: “Dora does not understand the hearts of women. You should study.”

lines.japanese: アリスは外に出てきたのがご不満みたいだ。さっきからほっぺたを膨らませてる。
lines.english: Alice appeared displeased about being taken outside. She had been puffing out her cheeks the entire time.

lines.japanese: 「ドラは子供、ドラはお子様、ドラはガキんちょ」
lines.english: “Dora is a child. Dora is a little child. Dora is a bratty kid.”

lines.japanese: 「おまえのことだよ」
lines.english: “You're describing yourself.”

lines.japanese: 「でもお兄ちゃんの言うとおり、ひとと話すのは大事なことだよ。私だって、国語の成績がいいわけじゃないし……」
lines.english: “But Big Brother is right. It’s important to speak with people. I’m not exactly good at Japanese class myself...”

lines.japanese: 「そうだ！　あそこで遊んでるみんなに混ぜてもらおう、ねっ？」
lines.english: “Oh, I know! Let's ask to join everyone playing over there. All right?”

lines.japanese: 「あそこ？」
lines.english: “Over there?”

lines.japanese: 「ねっ、私たちも混ぜて」
lines.english: “Hey! Can we join you?”

lines.japanese: 「えっ？」
lines.english: “Huh?”

lines.japanese: あ、さっき自動販売機の前で見かけた子だ。小鳩は公園でドッジボールをするその子たちに声をかけた。
lines.english: Oh, that was the child I had seen near the vending machine. Kobato called to the children playing dodgeball in the park.

lines.japanese: 「うん、いいよー。見かけない子だね」
lines.english: “Sure! I haven't seen you around before.”

lines.japanese: 「ふふっ、私、みんなよりお姉さんだよ」
lines.english: “Hee-hee. I'm older than all of you.”

lines.japanese: 兄から見ても同じ年にしか見えなかった。
lines.english: Even to her brother, she looked exactly their age.

lines.japanese: 「手加減してあげるからね」
lines.english: “I'll take it easy on you.”

lines.japanese: 手加減してもらう側にしか見えなかった。
lines.english: She looked solely like the one who would need everybody else to take it easy.

lines.japanese: 「じゃあコートに入りなよ」
lines.english: “Then get on the court.”

lines.japanese: 「よーし、お兄ちゃん、アリスちゃん、私ちょっと遊んでくるから待ってて」
lines.english: “All right! Big Brother, Alice, I’m going to play for a while. Wait here.”

lines.japanese: いつもはこんなに積極的じゃないけど、アリスのためにがんばってるのかな。小鳩は子供たちの中に入ってボールを手に取った。
lines.english: She was not normally this outgoing. Was she making the effort for Alice? Kobato joined the children and picked up the ball.

lines.japanese: 「じゃあいくよ。それっ！　わ、わわっ、取られた」
lines.english: “Here I go. Take that! W-whoa! They got it!”

lines.japanese: 「えーいっ」
lines.english: “Hyaa!”

lines.japanese: 「あー」
lines.english: “Aah!”

lines.japanese: そしてあっさり小鳩はやられた。
lines.english: And Kobato was eliminated with ease.

lines.japanese: 「だだだ大丈夫か小鳩！　よし、お兄ちゃんが仇を討ってやる」
lines.english: “K-K-Kobato, are you all right?! Your brother will avenge you!”

lines.japanese: 「い、いいよー、お兄ちゃんはそこで見てて。アリスちゃんに仇をとってもらうもん」
lines.english: “I-I’m fine! You watch from there, Big Brother. Alice will avenge me.”

lines.japanese: 「それはあまり期待しない方がいい」
lines.english: “You should not expect very much.”

lines.japanese: 「ね、アリスちゃんもやろうよ」
lines.english: “Come on, Alice. Play with us.”

lines.japanese: 「ちょっとでいいから」
lines.english: “Just for a little while.”

lines.japanese: 少し迷ったものの、小鳩にせがまれると断りきれなかったらしい。アリスは渋々コートの中に入った。
lines.english: She hesitated, but apparently couldn't refuse Kobato's pleading. Alice reluctantly entered the court.

lines.japanese: 「わ、すごーい！　本物の外国人のひとだ！」
lines.english: “Wow! A real live foreigner!”

lines.japanese: アリスはやる気がなさそうに視線をそらして突ったっていたが、ときどきチラチラといつ始まるのかを確認していた。
lines.english: Alice stood looking away with no apparent enthusiasm, yet kept stealing glances to see when the game would begin.

lines.japanese: 「じゃあいくよー」
lines.english: “Here I go!”

lines.japanese: 「はややっ、またこっちきた！」
lines.english: “Hwah! It's coming this way again!”

lines.japanese: 「小鳩、あぶない」
lines.english: “Kobato, look out.”

lines.japanese: 「Ｏｕｃｈ！」
lines.english: “Ouch!”

lines.japanese: 「わあっ！　あ、アリスちゃんが私の盾にっ！」
lines.english: “Wah! A-Alice used herself as my shield!”

lines.japanese: 「だ、大丈夫、問題はない。ミーをてーして味方を守る。これは言います、ジャパニーズ・ブシドー」
lines.english: “I-I am fine. No problem. Put the me on the line for my ally. This is called Japanese warrior code.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、アリス！　おまえってやつは……！」
lines.english: “A-Alice! You magnificent...!”

lines.japanese: 俺はコートの外で感動のあまり号泣しそうなのをなんとか抑えた。国籍は違えど、アリスこそ日本男児と呼ぶに相応しい。
lines.english: Outside the court, I barely restrained myself from sobbing with emotion. Whatever her nationality, Alice deserved to be called a true son of Japan.

lines.japanese: 「おまえの死は無駄にはしないからな！」
lines.english: “Your death will not be in vain!”

lines.japanese: 「ブシドーとは死ぬことと見つけたり」
lines.english: “The warrior's path is found in dying.”

lines.japanese: 「わあ、日本語上手だね」
lines.english: “Wow, your Japanese is really good.”

lines.japanese: 「えへん」
lines.english: “Ahem.”

lines.japanese: アリスは服についた砂を払いながら立ちあがった。
lines.english: Alice stood and brushed the dirt from her clothes.

lines.japanese: 「よおーし、じゃあ次いくよ。私がアリスちゃんの仇をうたないとっ……えいっ！」
lines.english: “All right! Now it's my turn. I have to avenge Alice... Take that!”

lines.japanese: 「Ｏｕｃｈ！」
lines.english: “Ouch!”

lines.japanese: 小鳩は味方であるはずのアリスにボールを叩きつけた。
lines.english: Kobato slammed the ball into Alice, who was supposed to be her teammate.

lines.japanese: 「はややっ！　ごごごゴメンねアリスちゃん！」
lines.english: “Hwah! I-I'm s-s-so sorry, Alice!”

lines.japanese: 背後からの奇襲をうけ、服を綺麗にしたばかりのアリスは、無残にも前のめりに突っぷした。
lines.english: Struck from ambush behind, Alice—who had only just cleaned her clothes—pitched forward in ruin.

lines.japanese: 「き、気にしなくていい。小鳩にトドメをさされるなら本望です。これが私の生きるみち」
lines.english: “D-do not worry. If Kobato deals me the final blow, I have no regrets. This is the path I live.”

lines.japanese: 「死んじゃったけどな」
lines.english: “Though technically you died.”

lines.japanese: 「あはは、面白いね」
lines.english: “Ahaha! You're funny.”

lines.japanese: 「いえ、まだまだ私は甘い。ゲイの道は一日にしてならず」
lines.english: “No. I am still a beginner. Rome wasn’t gay in a day.”

lines.japanese: 「おまえその諺、マルチネスに習ったんなら意味間違ってるからな」
lines.english: “If Martinez taught you that proverb, he taught you the wrong meaning.”

lines.japanese: 「あはははは」
lines.english: “Ahahahaha!”

lines.japanese: 「さあ、しまっていくー」
lines.english: “All right. Heads in the game!”

lines.japanese: いつの間にか、アリスが両手をぺちっと叩いて他の子供たちと同じようにボールを追いかけていた。
lines.english: Before I knew it, Alice was clapping her hands and chasing the ball like the other children.

lines.japanese: 「ばっちこい、ばっちこい」
lines.english: “Bring it on! Bring it on!”

lines.japanese: うわあ、そんなダイビングキャッチしたら綺麗な服が汚れる……あーあ、砂だらけだ。
lines.english: Whoa. That diving catch would ruin her nice clothes... Too late. Covered in dirt.

lines.japanese: だけどアリスはそんなことも気にせずにボールに向かって飛びこんでいた。
lines.english: But Alice dove after the ball without caring in the slightest.

lines.japanese: いいなあ、楽しそうだなあ。おれもやっちゃおうかなあ。
lines.english: That looked nice. Looked fun. Maybe I'll play too.

lines.japanese: いま一瞬、足を踏みだしかけた。い、いや、もちろん本気で混ざるつもりはない……なかったんだよな。
lines.english: For one instant, my foot had started forward. N-no, of course I had not seriously meant to join them... I hadn't, had I?

lines.japanese: だよな。
lines.english: No. Of course not.

lines.japanese: 俺は小鳩とアリスが他の子たちとボールを投げ合うのを眺めていた。
lines.english: I watched Kobato and Alice throw the ball back and forth with the other children.

lines.japanese: やがて日もとっぷりと暮れてボールが見えなくなった頃、別れ際に子供たちがアリスに手を振ってくれた。
lines.english: At last the sun went down and the ball vanished into the dark. When it was time to part, the children waved to Alice.

lines.japanese: 「アリスちゃん面白いね。また遊ぼうねー」
lines.english: “Alice, you're funny! Come play again!”

lines.japanese: 言葉をかけられた側は、蒼い目をまん丸にして、見てて気の毒なくらい固まった。
lines.english: Alice froze solid, her blue eyes so round I almost felt sorry for her.

lines.japanese: 俺と小鳩は笑いを堪えつつ、目の前の小さな背中をとんっと突つく。
lines.english: Kobato and I held back our laughter and each gave her a gentle nudge in the back.

lines.japanese: それでようやく気づいたアリスは、顔を真っ赤にしてようやく返事の声を口にした。
lines.english: At last Alice understood. Face burning red, she finally managed to answer.

lines.japanese: 「ま、またあした！」
lines.english: “S-see you tomorrow!”

lines.japanese: さて。アリスを保護者に届けたし、これからどうするかな。
lines.english: Well, then. Alice was safely back with her guardian. What next?

lines.japanese: メシは家で食べた。そのあとアリスを届けるため、小鳩は家において二人で駅前へと出てきた。
lines.english: We had eaten dinner at home. Afterward, I left Kobato there and accompanied Alice to the station.

lines.japanese: そうだ、また自転車探しの報告でもしに行くか。俺はパルクレープへと足を向けた。
lines.english: Right. I could go give another report on the bicycle search. I turned toward Paru Crêpes.

lines.japanese: 「おっ」
lines.english: “Oh.”

lines.japanese: タイミングよくホーメイも来てる。いや、自転車は見つかってないから悪いタイミングなのか？
lines.english: Homei had arrived at exactly the right time. Or was it the wrong time, since the bicycle had not turned up?

lines.japanese: にしてもなんだか楽しそうな顔してる。見てるこっちまで陽気にさせられる笑顔だ。
lines.english: Either way, she looked delighted. Her smile was cheerful enough to brighten anyone who saw it.

lines.japanese: 「うーす、パルさん」
lines.english: “Hey, Paru.”

lines.japanese: 俺は片手を上げながらやや明るめのトーンで話しかけた。
lines.english: I raised one hand and greeted her in a somewhat brighter voice than usual.

lines.japanese: 「おっ、ドラじゃないか」
lines.english: “Oh, if it isn't Dora.”

lines.japanese: 「あー、ほんとだー。ドラさん、おばんですー」
lines.english: “Oh! It really is. Good evening, Dora.”

lines.japanese: 「あれ、もう店じまい？」
lines.english: “What, closing already?”

lines.japanese: 近づいてみたら、パルさんが道具を洗いはじめていた。看板もホーメイが運ぼうとしてる。
lines.english: When I approached, Paru had begun washing her tools. Homei was preparing to carry the sign away too.

lines.japanese: 「なんだ、平日だからってさぼってるとお客さん減っちゃうぞ。ただでさえ少ないのに」
lines.english: “Come on. If you slack off just because it's a weekday, you'll lose customers. You barely have any as it is.”

lines.japanese: 「ふざけたこと言ってんじゃないよ。今日はちっとお祝いするから、早めに店じまいするってだけだよ」
lines.english: “Don't talk nonsense. We're having a little celebration today, that's all, so I'm closing early.”

lines.japanese: 「お祝い？」
lines.english: “A celebration?”

lines.japanese: ああ、それでさっきから楽しそうなのか。
lines.english: Ah. Was that why she had looked so happy?

lines.japanese: 「で、なんのお祝い？」
lines.english: “So what are we celebrating?”

lines.japanese: 「実はね、鳴坊がずっと自転車探してただろ。それが見つかったんだよ」
lines.english: “Well, you know how Naru's been searching for her bicycle all this time? She found it.”

lines.japanese: 「え、マジで？」
lines.english: “What? Seriously?”

lines.japanese: 「あははー、はい、そういうことでしてー、ドラさんにはご協力の数々ありがとうございましたー」
lines.english: “Ahaha. Yes, that's how it is. Dora, thank you for all the many ways you assisted me.”

lines.japanese: ホーメイは頭を深々と下げながらへらっと言ってのけた。へえ、見つかったんだ……。
lines.english: Homei said this with a vacant grin and a deep bow. Huh. She had found it...

lines.japanese: 「どこにあったの？」
lines.english: “Where was it?”

lines.japanese: 「はいー？」
lines.english: “Yes?”

lines.japanese: 「それで今日、さっそくパルさんに報告に来たんですよー」
lines.english: “So I came straight here today to report the news to Paru.”

lines.japanese: しばらく考えてからスルーされた。そんな、ひとに言えないような所で見つかったのか。
lines.english: She thought for a while, then ignored the question. Had she found it somewhere too shameful to mention?

lines.japanese: 「だから今日は早めに店を閉めて、鳴にラーメンでも食べさシてやろうと思ってね。あんたも来るかい？」
lines.english: “So I'm closing early and taking Naru out for ramen. You want to come?”

lines.japanese: 「ラーメン」
lines.english: “Ramen.”

lines.japanese: さっき夕飯食べたばっかりなんだけどな。でも腹の空き容量的には七分目だからまだイケる。どうしようかな……。
lines.english: I had only just eaten dinner. Still, my stomach was only seventy percent full. I could manage. What to do...

lines.japanese: 「あんたも見つけはしなかったけど、ここんとこは真面目にやってたみたいだからね。パル姉さんが奢ってやるよ」
lines.english: “You didn’t find it, but you’ve been putting in the effort. It’s my treat.”

lines.japanese: 「行く」
lines.english: “I'm coming.”

lines.japanese: 即答した。
lines.english: My answer was instantaneous.

lines.japanese: 「ラーメン二つに大盛り一つ。お待ちどう」
lines.english: “Two ramen and one large. Here you go.”

lines.japanese: 「お、きたきた」
lines.english: “Oh, here it is.”

lines.japanese: 寒空に湯気を立てて、机の上にラーメンの入ったどんぶりが三つ置かれた。俺たちは各々の注文を目の前に寄せる。
lines.english: Steam rising into the frigid air, three bowls of ramen were set on the table. We each drew our order toward us.

lines.japanese: 「いやあ、それにしても良かったなあ」
lines.english: “Still, I'm glad it worked out.”

lines.japanese: 「はいー、も、ほんとに感謝してますー。パルさんには色々と情報提供をいただきましてー」
lines.english: “Yes. I truly am grateful. You gave me all sorts of useful information, Paru.”

lines.japanese: 「なーに言ってやんでぇ、こんくらい大したことないってんだよ」
lines.english: “What're you talking about? That little bit was nothing.”

lines.japanese: ラーメンを食べて体が温まりはじめたころ、パル姉さんの気風のいい笑い声が飛んだ。悩み事なんか吹きとばしてくれそうな声だ。
lines.english: By the time the ramen had begun warming us, Paru's generous laughter rang out. It was the sort of voice that could blow your troubles clean away.

lines.japanese: 「そうだ、いいこと考えた。ホーメイ、おまえもう一回自転車なくせばいいじゃん。そんで今度は俺が見つければまたラーメン奢ってもらえるんじゃね？」
lines.english: “I just had a brilliant idea. Homei, lose your bicycle again. Then I can find it next time, and she'll have to buy us ramen again. Right?”

lines.japanese: 「はっ。ドラさんナイス悪巧みです、ひととしてはかなり最低ですが、知恵としては尊敬します」
lines.english: “Oh! An excellent wicked scheme, Dora. As a human being, you are appalling. As a source of wisdom, you command my respect.”

lines.japanese: 「本人の前で話すことじゃないけどな」
lines.english: “Not a plan you discuss in front of the person paying.”

lines.japanese: 「じゃあ今度は自動車でいけ」
lines.english: “Fine, lose a car next time.”

lines.japanese: 「そういう問題でもないけどな」
lines.english: “That is not the problem.”

lines.japanese: 「はー、ドラさんってパルさん相手だとボケに回るんですねー」
lines.english: “Oh. When you're with Paru, Dora, you play the fool.”

lines.japanese: 「いやね、俺そもそも芸人じゃないからね。それにこの女、どこから見てもツッコミのために生まれてきたような女だろう。ボケなんかしたことないに違いない」
lines.english: “For one thing, I'm not a comedian. And from any angle, this woman was born to play the straight man. She's probably never played the fool in her life.”

lines.japanese: 「あ？　人聞きの悪いこと言うんじゃないよ、どこから見ても優しい顔してんだろ」
lines.english: “Huh? Don't give people the wrong idea. Look at this gentle face.”

lines.japanese: 「おお、パルさんのボケなんか初めて聞いた」
lines.english: “Wow. That's the first joke I've ever heard from you.”

lines.japanese: 「はあ？　あたしがいつボケたってんだい」
lines.english: “Huh? When did I make a joke?”

lines.japanese: 「いや今、ご自分で女神のような顔だと」
lines.english: “Just now, when you described your own face as goddesslike.”

lines.japanese: 「その通りだろ？」
lines.english: “And rightly so.”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、背中に彫ってあるのか」
lines.english: “Oh. Is the goddess tattooed across your back?”

lines.japanese: 「誰が刺青なんか背負ってんだよ。ひとのこと極道扱いしやがるなら、ポン刀持って殴りこみいれてやろうか！」
lines.english: “Who the hell has a tattoo on her back? Keep treating me like a gangster, and I'll come storm your place with a sword!”

lines.japanese: 「まんまじゃねえか！　あんた素で怖えよ！」
lines.english: “That's exactly what I mean! You're terrifying without even trying!”

lines.japanese: 「あはは」
lines.english: “Ahaha.”

lines.japanese: ひとが命がけのツッコミを入れてる最中、ホーメイは呑気にスープをすすっていた。
lines.english: While I risked my life playing straight man, Homei serenely sipped her broth.

lines.japanese: 「うーん、お二人は面白いですねー、ずっとコントを見ていたいですー」
lines.english: “Hmm. You two are funny. I could watch your comedy routine forever.”

lines.japanese: 「おまえの頭でどつき漫才してやろうか」
lines.english: “Want me to make your head the centerpiece of a slapstick act?”

lines.japanese: 「はー、いいなー、楽しいなー。でも明日は終業式だし、学校に行かないとなー」
lines.english: “Oh. This is nice. I'm having fun. But tomorrow is the closing ceremony, so I'll have to go to school.”

lines.japanese: 「は？　今日だって学校帰りだろ」
lines.english: “What? You went to school today too, didn't you?”

lines.japanese: 「たはは、そうですよねー、なに言ってるんだろ私ー」
lines.english: “Tahaha. You're right. What am I talking about?”

lines.japanese: ホーメイはへらっと笑って、またスープをすする作業に戻った。
lines.english: Homei gave another vacant laugh and went back to sipping her broth.

lines.japanese: 「ん、どしたのパルさん。唇むっつり閉じて仁義のない顔になってるぞ」
lines.english: “Hm? What's wrong, Paru? Lips pressed tight, looking like you're fresh out of a gangster movie.”

lines.japanese: 「がんばれそうか？」
lines.english: “Think you can manage?”

lines.japanese: そんな俺の冗談には答えず、パルさんはふっと肉親のような笑みを漏らした。
lines.english: Ignoring my joke, Paru let slip a soft smile with the warmth of family.

lines.japanese: 「はいー、今日こうして話してたら、なんだか元気が出てきましたのでー」
lines.english: “Yes. Talking like this today has somehow cheered me up.”

lines.japanese: 「大げさだなあ……なんだ、通知表でも怖いのか」
lines.english: “That's dramatic... What, are you scared of your report card?”

lines.japanese: 「あー、それに近い傾向はありますねー」
lines.english: “Oh. There is a tendency in that general direction.”

lines.japanese: 「じゃあ仕方ないな、これやるよ」
lines.english: “Then I suppose it can't be helped. Here.”

lines.japanese: 俺は自分のトッピングから味つけ卵をホーメイの丼に入れてやった。
lines.english: I transferred the seasoned egg from my own toppings into Homei's bowl.

lines.japanese: 「あれー、これもらっていいんですかー？」
lines.english: “Oh? I can have this?”

lines.japanese: 「うんいいよ。え、なんで？」
lines.english: “Sure. Why wouldn't you?”

lines.japanese: 「だってドラさんってどけちなひとじゃないですかー」
lines.english: “Because you're a terrible miser, Dora.”

lines.japanese: 「え、誰がそんなこと言ってたの」
lines.english: “Who told you that?”

lines.japanese: 「はー、私ですねー」
lines.english: “Oh. I did.”

lines.japanese: 「え、これケンカ？　恩を仇で返されてる？　俺？」
lines.english: “What, are we fighting now? Is this how you repay a favor? Me?”

lines.japanese: 「今日のドラさんちょっと優しくありません？」
lines.english: “Aren't you being a little kind today, Dora?”

lines.japanese: 「いやそんな、卵あげただけでそこまで大げさに喜ばれても」
lines.english: “Come on. I gave you an egg. You don't have to celebrate it like a miracle.”

lines.japanese: 「あはー」
lines.english: “Aha.”

lines.japanese: そしてやつはパルさんの方に向きなおって言った。
lines.english: Then she turned back toward Paru and spoke.

lines.japanese: 「あの私ー、やっぱりがんばれそうな気がしてきましたー」
lines.english: “I think... I really may be able to do my best after all.”

lines.japanese: 「そうか、良かったじゃないか」
lines.english: “You do? That's wonderful.”

lines.japanese: 「はいー」
lines.english: “Yes.”

lines.japanese: なんだかよく分からないけどよかったらしい。ホーメイはそのあとずっとにこにこしていた。
lines.english: I didn't quite understand, but apparently it was good news. Homei kept smiling for the rest of the evening.

lines.japanese: 別れ際ホーメイが、自転車を探してもらって本当にありがとうございましたとお礼を言ってきたので、隼人らしくおうよと答えておいた。
lines.english: When we parted, Homei thanked me with great sincerity for helping search for her bicycle. I gave her a suitably Hayato-like ‘Sure.’

lines.japanese: そのお礼が丁寧だったので、自転車が見つかってよかったなと、別れて数歩進んだ今さらながらに思ってしまった。
lines.english: The thanks had been so earnest that, several steps after we parted, it finally occurred to me how glad I was that she'd found it.

lines.japanese: 仕方ないから応援だけはしてやろう。がんばれホーメイ。
lines.english: I supposed I could at least cheer her on. Do your best, Homei.
